overview: 28‑day intensive RLHF evaluation training for Outlier AI (B2 → C1). 2 h/day.

weeks.objective: Parse dense guidelines & multi‑constraint prompts at speed.
weeks.metrics: ≤ 30 s to extract all explicit/implicit constraints; 90 % accuracy in constraint‑identification quizzes.

days.title: Guideline taxonomy & note‑taking system
days.activities: Read 2 complex Outlier prompts; annotate explicit, implicit, negative constraints; create a master checklist. 10‑min timed extraction practice.

days.title: Tone & persona mapping
days.activities: Analyze 3 model responses for tone/persona compliance; build a tone‑lexicon table. 15‑min speed drill.

days.title: Verbosity & redundancy detection
days.activities: Compare Model A vs B on word‑count and redundancy; mark violations. 20‑min timed task.

days.title: Constraint hierarchy & conflict resolution
days.activities: Case study: overlapping constraints. Write a short hierarchy diagram. 15‑min.

days.title: Micro‑parsing sprint
days.activities: 10 prompts, 30‑s per prompt to list all constraints. Record time & errors. 30‑min.

days.title: Weekend Review & Quiz
days.activities: Mixed‑question quiz (20 items) on weeks 1 concepts; review errors. 1 h.

days.title: Reflection & Personal Cheat‑Sheet
days.activities: Summarize personal parsing shortcuts; create a one‑page cheat‑sheet. 1 h.

weeks.objective: Detect hallucinations, logical fallacies, and partial constraint breaches.
weeks.metrics: ≥ 85 % correct identification of hallucinated facts; ≤ 5 s to flag a logical inconsistency.

days.title: Fact‑checking workflow
days.activities: Use a 3‑step verification template on 5 statements. 20‑min.

days.title: Hallucination taxonomy
days.activities: Study 4 hallucination types; annotate examples from Model A/B. 25‑min.

days.title: Logical chain validation
days.activities: Map reasoning chain of a model answer; spot missing premise. 30‑min.

days.title: Safety & toxicity boundaries
days.activities: Scan 3 responses for prohibited content; label severity. 20‑min.

days.title: Partial‑constraint spotting
days.activities: Identify 2‑sentence responses that meet some constraints but violate others. 25‑min.

days.title: Weekend Mock Evaluation
days.activities: Full evaluation (prompt → two responses → justification) under 30 min. Record score. 1 h.

days.title: Debrief & Error Log
days.activities: Write a 300‑word error‑analysis report; update personal log. 45 min.

weeks.objective: Write C1‑level CEE justifications that are concise, evidence‑rich, and persuasive.
weeks.metrics: Score ≥ 4.5/5 on the Outlier rubric for clarity, evidence, and style.

days.title: CEE framework deep dive
days.activities: Study 5 exemplar justifications; annotate claim, evidence, explanation. 30‑min.

days.title: Advanced evaluative vocabulary
days.activities: Learn 20 C1‑level adjectives/adverbs (e.g., ‘substantially’, ‘incongruous’). Flashcard drill 15‑min.

days.title: Template 1 – Hallucination justification
days.activities: Apply template to a new hallucination case; 10‑min draft, 5‑min peer‑review simulation.

days.title: Template 2 – Instruction‑drop justification
days.activities: Write using Claim‑Evidence‑Explanation; focus on linking to explicit constraint. 15‑min.

days.title: Template 3 – Verbosity/Redundancy justification
days.activities: Craft concise justification; limit to 100 words. 20‑min.

days.title: Speed‑write sprint
days.activities: 5 mini‑tasks, 7 min each, produce full CEE justification. 35‑min total.

days.title: Weekend Review & Rubric Calibration
days.activities: Grade 10 past justifications against official rubric; identify 3 improvement patterns. 1 h.

weeks.objective: Execute full assessment workflow under test conditions and neutralize Outlier traps.
weeks.metrics: Complete ≥ 3 full mock assessments within 30 min each, with ≥ 85 % rubric score; zero trap‑failures.

days.title: Timed full mock #1
days.activities: 30‑min timer: parse prompt, analyze two responses, write justification. Record time & score.

days.title: Trap analysis – hidden constraints
days.activities: Study 5 “gotcha” prompts; list hidden cues; create a checklist. 30‑min.

days.title: Timed full mock #2 (different domain)
days.activities: Same workflow on a technical prompt (e.g., code explanation). 30‑min.

days.title: Checklist & cheat‑sheet finalization
days.activities: Produce printable one‑page sheet (key vocab, templates, trap alerts). 45‑min.

days.title: Timed full mock #3 – stress test
days.activities: 30‑min under simulated exam environment (no notes). 30‑min.

days.title: Performance review & gap analysis
days.activities: Compare scores of three mocks; identify 2 recurring weaknesses; plan corrective drills.

days.title: Pre‑exam mindset & final run‑through
days.activities: Light 20‑min mock, followed by confidence affirmation writing. 30‑min.
